parts.text: You are going to investigate the rate of reaction between hydrochloric acid and aqueous sodium thiosulfate. When these chemicals react they form a precipitate which makes the solution go cloudy. The formation of this precipitate can be used to show how fast the reaction proceeds. Read all the instructions below carefully before starting the experiments. Instructions You are going to carry out ﬁ ve experiments using the apparatus shown below. aqueous sodium thiosulfate eye 10 cm 3 of hydrochloric acid 250 cm 3 conical flask printed insert printed text

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Experiment 1 Use the large measuring cylinder to pour 50 cm 3 of aqueous sodium thiosulfate into a conical ﬂ ask. Place the conical ﬂ ask on the printed insert provided. Fill the small measuring cylinder with 10 cm 3 of the hydrochloric acid provided. Add the acid to the solution in the conical ﬂ ask and immediately start your timer and swirl the mixture. Measure the time taken for the printed text to disappear from view. Record the time in the table. Pour the solution away and rinse the conical ﬂ ask with distilled water.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Experiment 2 Use the large measuring cylinder to pour 40 cm 3 of aqueous sodium thiosulfate into the conical ﬂ ask, followed by 10 cm 3 of distilled water. Place the conical ﬂ ask on the printed insert. Fill the small measuring cylinder with 10 cm 3 of the hydrochloric acid provided. Add the acid to the solution in the ﬂ ask, start your timer and swirl the mixture. Measure the time taken for the printed text to disappear from view. Record the time in the table.

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Experiment 3 Repeat Experiment 2 using 35 cm 3 of aqueous sodium thiosulfate and 15 cm 3 of distilled water. Record the time in the table.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Experiment 4 Repeat Experiment 2 using 30 cm 3 of aqueous sodium thiosulfate and 20 cm 3 of distilled water. Record the time in the table.

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Experiment 5 Repeat Experiment 2 using 20 cm 3 of aqueous sodium thiosulfate and 30 cm 3 of distilled water. Record the time in the table.
